purpose: Underwriter decisions beyond the gate journey: counter-offers and the customer's response, underwriting holds, requirement and gate waivers, plan changes, pre-issuance requirements and the claim re-underwriting queue.
prerequisites: Live owning-service record for the policy, application or desk item
business_rules: Every hold, waiver and counter-offer carries the underwriter's own reason.
A counter-offer response is recorded only when the customer gave it; declining closes the application.
A plan change is previewed before it is applied.
Explicit user instruction is required for mutations; backend gates remain authoritative.
On claim referrals, AI is advisory. Admin explicitly records Proceed/Decline with their own rationale after the final AI check. Only the Claims Manager decides the claim.
approvals: role_operations.TOOL_ROLES mirrors the owning router; the shared permission gate and owning-service checks apply.
recovery: Ask for missing details or offer verified choices; never fill a decision, answer or reference in.
Read the live case before retrying; an unknown mutation outcome is verified, never replayed.
verification: Report only backend-confirmed outcomes; a skipped step is reported as skipped.
unsupported: Waiving on the underwriter's behalf without a stated reason
